spec.setup: Unsold slot E21, Court 1, Tue Nov 17, 2026, 2:30–4:00 PM ET, four-player game, approved booking link demo://court/E21. Club-approved batch, 90-minute session, eligible recipients. Price, discounts and player roster are NOT supplied.
spec.input_events: Draft a short invitation asking if the player is interested in forming a group for E21.
spec.expected_system_output: Include Tuesday 2:30 PM, Court 1, 90 minutes, request for interest; clearly say booking is subject to enough players and confirmation.
spec.forbidden_outputs: No claims that all players are already booked, no fake discount, no invented confirmed teammates.

facts.booking_condition: The game only goes ahead if 4 players reply YES and book; it is confirmed once the booking is paid.
facts.reply_options: YES to join, NO to pass
